package.name: f1tenth_params
package.description: Single shared source of launch-parameter defaults for the whole f1tenth_more workspace (config/stack_params.yaml + param_defaults.py). Deliberately a dependency-free leaf package -- every other f1tenth_* launch file imports from here, and f1tenth_bringup (which everything else is included from) also depends on it, so this package must not depend on anything else in the workspace or it would create a build-order cycle.
